name: PR86 owner-scoped native trait grant and one-title appointment

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_LeaderPersonaNativeRead)=='function'

steps.code: local leader='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local row=assert(GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[leader]); local def=assert(GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]); assert(def.TraitType=='TRAIT_JAC_TEST_ASHINA_JOINED'); local ids=PlayerManager.GetAliveMajorIDs(); assert(#ids==22,'requires 22 living major players'); local seen={}; local n=0; for _,id in ipairs(ids) do assert(not seen[id],'duplicate player'); seen[id]=true; local gov=assert(Players[id]:GetGovernors()); local persons=0; for person in GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas() do local d=assert(GameInfo.Governors[person.GovernorType]); assert(not gov:CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash),'unjoined candidate open: '..id..'/'..person.LeaderType); n=n+1; persons=persons+1 end; assert(persons==22,'requires 22 persons per player') end; assert(n==484); assert(not Players[0]:GetGovernors():HasGovernor(def.Hash)); return 'all 484 native player/person pairs closed before joining'
UI.RequestPlayerOperation(Game.GetLocalPlayer(),PlayerOperations.EXECUTE_SCRIPT,{OnStart='JAC_TestPersonaTraitGrantPrepare'}); return 'real Join, title reservation and owner modifier requested'

local leader='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local receipt=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST_PERSONA_TRAIT_GRANT_RECEIPT')); local row=assert(GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[leader]); local def=assert(GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]); local g=assert(Players[0]:GetGovernors()); assert(receipt.owner==0 and receipt.source==2 and receipt.leader==leader); assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..leader..'_OWNER')==0 and Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..leader..'_STATE')=='EVOLVING'); assert(g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==receipt.beforeSpent and receipt.total-receipt.spent>=1); return 'attached receipt; CanEver='..tostring(g:CanEverAppointGovernor(def.Hash))..'; total='..receipt.total..'; spent='..receipt.spent

local leader='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local row=assert(GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[leader]); local def=assert(GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]); local ids=PlayerManager.GetAliveMajorIDs(); assert(#ids==22,'requires 22 living major players'); local seen={}; local n=0; for _,id in ipairs(ids) do assert(not seen[id],'duplicate player'); seen[id]=true; local gov=assert(Players[id]:GetGovernors()); local persons=0; for person in GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas() do local d=assert(GameInfo.Governors[person.GovernorType]); local allowed=gov:CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash); assert(allowed==(id==0 and person.LeaderType==leader),'wrong native eligibility: '..id..'/'..person.LeaderType); n=n+1; persons=persons+1 end; assert(persons==22,'requires 22 persons per player') end; assert(n==484); local g=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); assert(g:CanAppointGovernor(def.Hash) and not g:HasGovernor(def.Hash)); return 'all 484 native pairs checked; only joined owner 0/Ashina admitted'

local row=GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas['LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO']; local d=GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]; UI.RequestPlayerOperation(0,PlayerOperations.APPOINT_GOVERNOR,{[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GOVERNOR_TYPE]=d.Index}); return 'official APPOINT sent once'

condition.code: local r=Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST_PERSONA_TRAIT_GRANT_RECEIPT'); local row=GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas['LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO']; local d=GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]; local g=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); return r and g:HasGovernor(d.Hash) and g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==r.beforeSpent+1

steps.code: local leader='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local receipt=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST_PERSONA_TRAIT_GRANT_RECEIPT')); local row=assert(GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[leader]); local def=assert(GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]); local g=assert(Players[0]:GetGovernors()); local governor=assert(g:GetGovernor(def.Hash)); assert(g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==receipt.beforeSpent+1 and governor:HasPromotion(GameInfo.GovernorPromotions[row.BasePromotionType].Hash)); assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..leader..'_STATE')=='EVOLVING'); return 'native APPOINT spent exactly one title and owns base promotion'

local l='LEADER_JAC_ASHINA_MORIKIYO'; local receipt=Game:GetProperty('JAC_TEST_PERSONA_TRAIT_GRANT_RECEIPT'); local row=GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[l]; local d=GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]; local p=Players[0]; local g=p:GetGovernors(); assert(g:HasGovernor(d.Hash) and g:GetGovernorPointsSpent()==receipt.beforeSpent+1); local people=0; for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do local gp=u:GetGreatPerson(); local individual=gp and gp:IsGreatPerson() and GameInfo.GreatPersonIndividuals[gp:GetIndividual()]; if individual and individual.GreatPersonIndividualType==row.PersonType then people=people+1 end end; assert(people==0 and Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..l..'_UNIT')==nil); return 'real GP absent only after native APPOINT and official payment'
